ns2:course.label: Fiber Optic Communications
ns2:course.description: Characterization, design, and lab measurements of optical fibers and lightwave channels, optical transmitters, receivers, and amplifiers; quantum and thermal noise processes; design of optical receivers; multimode and single-mode link analysis. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECE 350.
